source.delta: Six business/documentation files plus eight checkpoint receipts; all changed production C, Rust tests and documentation inspected once. Closed unchanged original/kernel/observer evidence was reused, not rerun.

prior_review.disposition: All four listed residual groups addressed in inspected source. No new actionable source finding established in this delta; runtime validation remains required.

judgement: NO_NEW_SOURCE_FINDINGS. This is a bounded source judgement, not compiler/runtime/FP/product/shipping acceptance, formal GitHub approval or Task 51/D3 completion.

inspected_corrections.facts: Float initialization, simple-weather selection and result staging now occur within the C guard. ENV_FP_SETTLE forces staged objects into memory before restoration; post-restore output/field transfers use memcpy/memset and integer decisions. Mutating operations retain copy-before-commit, and a failed restore withholds the field commit. The restored x87 CW/SW/TW are read through a saved/reloaded fnstenv image and compared unmasked; full MXCSR is compared. Entry-failure, operation-refusal, normal and need_draw branches retain restoration. No unrelated generic DLL FP repair was introduced.
inspected_corrections.test_scope: Matrix now arranges four x87 by four SSE rounding combinations, two MXCSR sticky arrangements and three complete x87 status arrangements, all-empty tag word. It compares full CW/SW/TW/MXCSR and includes accepted/refused init_random, weather/simple, wind with/without vector, gust, import/export, init_fixed, no-expiry/NeedDraw/Done, missing camera, invalid draw/gust and infinite timer refusals. RestoreFp restores the saved x87 image and MXCSR on test exit/unwind. Numeric equality comparisons happen after the matrix and do not contaminate subsequent checked cases.

inspected_corrections.facts: C requires a finite speed always and a finite vector only when requested, matching the existing Rust/Lua contract. The new test installs an ABI-compatible C callback and invokes the actual campaign_env_wind_at consumer for requested-valid, unrequested-valid and unrequested-nonfinite vectors. Requested-malformed behavior is explicitly left to the later engine-level authority witness, not claimed measured here.
inspected_corrections.isolation: The installed callback is a static function with null user context, copied by C, so no stack-context pointer dangles. It remains installed for the test process. Source search found this is the only campaign_env_set_host/campaign_env_wind_at user within this engine unit binary; other with_host unit cases call Rust callbacks directly and do not install the C environment host or boot an engine. No present competing C environment consumer or cross-test race was established. Separate test executables are separate processes.

inspected_corrections.facts: The first server expiry answer now checks the decremented timer for finiteness before returning need_draw success. An invalid timer refuses while the field copy remains uncommitted. The focused test retains the infinite-delta refusal, checks unchanged state, then checks ordinary finite NeedDraw. The matrix retains this refusal too. No blanket input validation or arbitrary phase cutoff was restored.

The camera test now checks that the first zero-radius local step evolves the radius to 5000 and then legitimately refuses a missing camera without mutation. It re-imports the original calm state before independently checking an absent camera in the original zero-radius/global branch. Production radius evolution and required-camera refusal are preserved.

preserved_evidence.verification: All seven payload receipts listed by receipt.json matched their declared CRLF-to-LF normalized SHA256 and byte counts. The original raw publication identities and normalization are explicit; immutable originals were not edited or rerun.
preserved_evidence.actual_prior_results: Inspected preserved 2afd records: actual Windows engine 76/76 exit 0 and dc 21/21 exit 0; world 247 pass / 2 fail exit 101, matching Linux. Windows build/export exit 0. The three 164-case retail probes retain complete 705-line equality to 05b (704 original raw lines plus metadata), 46 payloads, native/pre/post exits 0. These are prior-candidate results, not d4 results.
preserved_evidence.diagnostics: WEATHER_DRAW w0 remains a declared private diagnostic-semantic difference. No original RAW/golden/tolerance was changed or treated as physically unchanged by that difference.

limitations: No d4 actual compiler/test/probe completion result was supplied to this review at its cutoff. Root owns running Linux/Windows builds, actual exported Windows tests and fresh numeric/public authority checks; source changes and matrix declarations are not measured success.

The FP matrix intentionally exercises an empty x87 tag stack and the listed status/mask arrangements, not every possible nonempty x87 register stack or control-mask combination. Its Field/Rust glue also executes in the seeded environment; on x87-only targets a reported status difference must be attributed using the actual call boundary. The documentation acknowledges this, and no runtime success is inferred.

Source reasoning and receipt hashing do not prove generated machine-code FP ordering across all targets. The new full-status target runs are an outstanding validation gate, not grounds for repeating unchanged originals.

The C-consumer test is bounded to its current standalone unit process; it is not a public Lua -> DLL -> real campaign wind-authority demonstration or requested-malformed witness. The preserved partial wind driver is outside this source and unaccepted.

No process changes, builds, native experiments, shared build volumes, credentials/authentication changes, external messages, fake reviews, merges or source edits performed by reviewer. The frozen tree remains clean.

Root supplies current live authority/user authorization and will handle normal review/merge gates. Whole D3 remains required; physical effects, scratch/time/loader/spatial/model residuals and full 40-check/eight-COMPLETE shipping acceptance are not closed by this review. Task 51/D3 incomplete; D4/D5 not started.
